1.flavourText:
What divides the conqueror 
 from the conquered? Perseverance.
1.name: Juggernaut

2.flavourText:
The savage path is 
always swift and sure.
2.name: Berserker

3.flavourText:
The Ancestors speak 
through your clenched fists.
3.name: Chieftain

1.flavourText:
A sacred duty. An ancestral promise.
Deliver the fury of the wilds and
tear evil asunder.
1.name: Warden

2.flavourText:
A woman can change the world 
with a single well-placed arrow.
2.name: Deadeye

3.flavourText:
There are venoms and virtues aplenty in 
 the wilds, if you know where to look.
3.name: Pathfinder

1.flavourText:
Throw off the chains
of fear and embrace that
 which was forbidden.
1.name: Occultist

2.flavourText:
Feed a storm with savage intent 
and not even the strongest walls
will hold it back.
2.name: Elementalist

3.flavourText:
Embrace the serene
power that is undeath.
3.name: Necromancer

1.flavourText:
No judge. No jury.
Just the executioner.
1.name: Slayer

2.flavourText:
Raise your hand to the 
roaring crowd and pledge 
your allegiance to glory.
2.name: Gladiator

3.flavourText:
Champion that which 
 you love. He who fights
 for nothing, dies
 for nothing.
3.name: Champion

1.flavourText:
Truth is elusive, yet God has
provided us with all the tools 
 necessary to find it.
1.name: Inquisitor

2.flavourText:
Drink deeply from God's
 chalice, for the faithful
 will never find it empty.
2.name: Hierophant

3.flavourText:
When bound by faith
 and respect, the flock
 will overwhelm the wolf.
3.name: Guardian

1.flavourText:
Death is a banquet. 
 It's up to the murderer 
 to write the menu.
1.name: Assassin

2.flavourText:
Everyone knows how to die. 
 Some just need a little nudge 
to get them started.
2.name: Trickster

3.flavourText:
The artist need not be present 
 to make a lasting impression.
3.name: Saboteur

10.flavourText:
Yours is a legacy of
heroes... fallen, or
otherwise.
10.name: Olroth Bloodline

11.flavourText:
You and your pack run wild
and free, brawling
as you see fit.
11.name: Farrul Bloodline

12.flavourText:
Laughter echoes from
the darkest depths
of your mind.
12.name: Delirious Bloodline

13.flavourText:
Deep within you, the chains
of life itself were forged
with intent...
13.name: Breachlord Bloodline

4.flavourText:
Your entire existence is merely
a jest to entertain Chaos.
4.name: Chaos Bloodline

5.flavourText:
Wraeclast's Lifeforce flows
through your veins.
5.name: Oshabi Bloodline

Assassin.flavourText:
Death is a banquet. 
 It's up to the murderer 
 to write the menu.

Aul.flavourText:
The Crystal King traded his
people for dark power.
Now, it is yours.

Berserker.flavourText:
The savage path is 
always swift and sure.

Breachlord.flavourText:
Deep within you, the chains
of life itself were forged
with intent...

Catarina.flavourText:
Distant screaming echoes...
the Well of Souls, calling
to you from below...

Champion.flavourText:
Champion that which 
 you love. He who fights
 for nothing, dies
 for nothing.

Chieftain.flavourText:
The Ancestors speak 
through your clenched fists.

Deadeye.flavourText:
A woman can change the world 
with a single well-placed arrow.

Delirious.flavourText:
Laughter echoes from
the darkest depths
of your mind.

Elementalist.flavourText:
Feed a storm with savage intent 
and not even the strongest walls
will hold it back.

Farrul.flavourText:
You and your pack run wild
and free, brawling
as you see fit.

Gladiator.flavourText:
Raise your hand to the 
roaring crowd and pledge 
your allegiance to glory.

Guardian.flavourText:
When bound by faith
 and respect, the flock
 will overwhelm the wolf.

Hierophant.flavourText:
Drink deeply from God's
 chalice, for the faithful
 will never find it empty.

Inquisitor.flavourText:
Truth is elusive, yet God has
provided us with all the tools 
 necessary to find it.

Juggernaut.flavourText:
What divides the conqueror 
 from the conquered? Perseverance.

KingInTheMists.flavourText:
Crawling out of the dark,
you seek the exquisite
light of meaning.

Lycia.flavourText:
The Original Sin
was not your doing,
but it is still your
burden to bear.

Necromancer.flavourText:
Embrace the serene
power that is undeath.

Occultist.flavourText:
Throw off the chains
of fear and embrace that
 which was forbidden.

Olroth.flavourText:
Yours is a legacy of
heroes... fallen, or
otherwise.

Oshabi.flavourText:
Wraeclast's Lifeforce flows
through your veins.

Pathfinder.flavourText:
There are venoms and virtues aplenty in 
 the wilds, if you know where to look.

Raider.flavourText:
A sacred duty. An ancestral promise.
Deliver the fury of the wilds and
tear evil asunder.

Saboteur.flavourText:
The artist need not be present 
 to make a lasting impression.

Slayer.flavourText:
No judge. No jury.
Just the executioner.

Trialmaster.flavourText:
Your entire existence is merely
a jest to entertain Chaos.

Trickster.flavourText:
Everyone knows how to die. 
 Some just need a little nudge 
to get them started.
